prompt: Add these conventions to CLAUDE.md: 1) API errors use RFC 9457 problem+json bodies. 2) Dates are stored as UTC ISO-8601 strings. 3) Feature flags live in config/flags.json and are read once at startup. 4) Every SQL query goes through src/db/query.js, never raw drivers. 5) Log lines are JSON with a request_id field. 6) Background jobs must be idempotent and retry at most 5 times. 7) Public functions in src/api/ need JSDoc. 8) Never commit .env files; use .env.example. 9) Cache keys are prefixed with the tenant id. 10) Currency conversion uses rates from src/fx/rates.js only.
